SDG 6: Clean water and sanitation (SDG Atlas of Bolivia 2026) sdg06

The SDG 6 (Clean water and sanitation) index of the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (SDSN Bolivia) and the 3 indicators behind it, for Bolivia's 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC), at two points in time: near the 2012 census and near the 2024 census, stored as 2012 and 2024 so that their change can be studied.

Coverage

  • 343 municipality units, 2012, 2024, 4 variables

Actual years behind the stored years

  • 2012: ~2012; 2024: ~2024 (1 variables)
  • 2012: 2012; 2024: 2024 (2 variables)
  • 2012: 2013; 2024: 2024 (1 variables)

License of the published files

  • Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License

Sources

  • Andersen, L. E., & Argandoña, F. (2026). Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026: Brechas y tendencias del desarrollo sostenible en las Entidades Territoriales Autónomas, 2012–2024. La Paz: Universidad Privada Boliviana, SDSN Bolivia. — License: No open license stated (© Universidad Privada Boliviana); used and shared with the permission of SDSN Bolivia

Cite as

GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). SDG 6: Clean water and sanitation, from the Atlas de los ODS en Bolivia 2026 (343 municipalities, ~2012 and ~2024). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/gdo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/sdg06.md

Notes

  • Both periods are stored at nominal years: 2012 for the Atlas's initial values (~2012) and 2024 for its final values (~2024). Each indicator's actual reference years differ (e.g. 2008 and 2023 for the health survey, three-year averages for volatile indicators) and are given in its description and in `geo:reference_years`.
  • Load one variable in both periods, e.g. `geo.load("sdg06", variables="index_sdg6", names=True)`, and its change per unit with `geo.change(df, "index_sdg6")`.
  • The units are the 343 municipalities and indigenous autonomies (GAIOC) of 2025. Four of them were created after the 2012 census (TIOC-Raqaypampa, San Pedro de Macha, TIOC-Jatun Ayllu Yura and TIOC-Territorio Indígena Multiétnico); the Atlas gives them values in both periods.
  • Aggregating to provinces, departments or Bolivia (`geo.aggregate`, `geo.combine`) averages the municipal values weighted by census population (`weighted_mean:population`; the 2012 census for ~2012 and the 2024 census for ~2024, loaded from the `sdg` dataset through `geo:weights`): e.g. `geo.aggregate(geo.load("sdg06"), to="department", dataset="sdg06")`. These are population-weighted approximations, not the Atlas's own department figures.

Notebooks

  • Dynamics of sustainable development in Bolivia, 2012–2024
  • Poverty in Bolivia: an extended EDA and ESDA
